ns2:course.label: Sustainable Design
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplanary Grand Challenge Learning pilot course in the Sustainability, Energy & the Environment pathway. Provides an introduction to sustainable art forms, media, and/or the social function of art as it relates to sustainability. Topics vary by section. Each section emphasizes experiential learning through design-based thinking and practice supplemented by field trips and community-engaged scholarship in comparative contexts. Prerequisite: Restricted to first-year freshman and transfer students.
